Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <1131621591.0...@z14g2000cwz.googlegroups.com>,

Disco Stu <worm...@vampirethemasquerade.com> writes:
>FYI, there are a bunch of different Ravnos lines in WoD but almost
>every single one has the standard Animalism, Chimerstry and Fortitude
>as core disciplines. The only exception are the Indian Brahman lineage,
>who have Auspex instead of Fortitude. Those Brahmin who came to Europe
>with Gypsies became called Phuri Dae, from memory.

My copy of Clanbook: Ravnos ((c) 1997... I can't remember if there was a
revised one) has the Phuri Dae marked down as commonly taking Auspex and
being knowledgeable about the Jyhad and their inevitable role within it,
but doesn't actually gift them Auspex as a discipline.

The example Phuri Dae (The Seer) in the book is given Animalism,
Fortitude and Chimerstry as the standard three disciplines (printed on
the sheet), and then given Auspex as a "hand-written" discipline.
Notably, however, The Seer doesn't take any points in Fortitude.

Of course, this may have been revised in later supplements.
